MAC RELEASE

Mac 1.5.14 · build 30

Connect DaouOffice inside the app to read events and leave.

Previous Mac release2026-10-15
HighlightsImprovementsSupport and limitsDownloads

Highlights

Manage your DaouOffice connection in Settings → Plugins. Supports a standard account login and CAPTCHA entered by the user.

Read leave for the current year and events for the current month in the app’s calendar. For example, connect the DaouOffice plugin, then open Calendar to review this month’s meetings and this year’s leave.

Improvements

  • Separates attendance calculations from calendar and settings integrations, supporting a base app without the DaouOffice module.
  • Keeps login information in the local Keychain and masks account and authentication information in logs.
  • Preserves existing attendance records, calendar connections, and the update public key.

Mac 1.5.15 includes this integration plus a new today view, optional plugins, and appearance settings. For a new installation, check the latest Mac release first.

Support and limits

macOS 13 or later; Universal app for Apple Silicon and Intel. The DaouOffice plugin is for Mac and is developed by 손정열.

This connection reads server data. It does not create, edit, or delete remote events or leave. Two-way synchronization between macOS calendars is a separate feature. SSO and additional two-factor authentication are not automated; compatibility depends on company configuration and service version.

Uses a fixed self-signed certificate and Sparkle update signatures. Apple Developer ID signing and notarization are not applied. App replacement, relaunch, calendar-permission retention, and execution on other Macs or physical Intel hardware remain separate validation scopes for this version.

Downloads

Open the DMG and move HappyLulu to Applications, or extract the ZIP and move the app. Quit the existing app before replacing it.
